liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **El Paso @ (1)** (1 review, 1 other source): Bobby plays acoustic guitar on El Paso, which the reviewer found cool to hear; El Paso is marked with an asterisk in the notes, and the set closes with Brokedown Palace as encore [2][6]
- **Feel Like a Stranger** (1 review): Reviewer praises Feel Like a Stranger as the opener [14]
- **Birdsong** (1 other source): A significant dropout in the DAT during Bird Song was patched using a B&K source [3]
- **So Many Roads** (1 review): Reviewer calls it one of the best versions of So Many Roads [13]
- **Terrapin** (1 review): Reviewer enjoyed the long Terrapin Station [14]
- **Stella Blue** (1 review): Reviewer singles out Stella Blue as nice [7]

## Setlist highlights

- **Sampson & Deliah**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [18]
- **Longway Home**: rare: 6 archived performances [18]

## The recordings

- **gd1994-10-19.aud.laporte.91913.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 18 songs; 157 min; rated 3.5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd94-10-19.bk4011.wiley.7744.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 17 songs; 170 min; rated 3.88/5 by 8 [2]. Said about its sound: Sound quality is mediocre; the crowd is clearly audible, with people asking for lighters, chatting about the previous night's show, and singing along; Reviewer says the audience recording sounds very good, with expected crowd interaction; Reviewer finds this a very good, crisp audience copy, noting the 4011 mics are excellent [6][7][10]
- **gd1994-10-19.akg460.flaschner.sobel.85410.flac16**: source not stated; 17 songs; 164 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [3]
- **gd1994-10-19.137089.sbd.miller.flac1648**: soundboard; 17 songs; 158 min; rated 2.33/5 by 3 [4]

## Around the show

- Audience chatter between and during songs is audible on the recording, which the reviewer finds amusing [14]
- Tape flips after El Paso and during Space leave gaps: a few seconds of crowd noise and of space missing [1]
- Reviewer points to the 21 February 1992 show for comparison, regarding So Many Roads and Jerry [8]
- Reviewer says the show is much better than its date or setlist suggests [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1994-10-19.aud.laporte.91913.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Chris LaPorte; source: Unknown Mics > Unknown Deck > Marantz PMD430. [1]. Also: Recorded on one Maxell MX90 and one Maxell MX110 tape, with flips occurring during the show [1]
- **gd94-10-19.bk4011.wiley.7744.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Paul Bottiglio; transferred by Tim Wiley; source: Audience: B&K 4011's [2]. Also: Reviewer notes that, if the lineage is accurate, there seems to be no external preamp in the chain [10]
- **gd1994-10-19.akg460.flaschner.sobel.85410.flac16**: taped by Dave Flaschner; transferred by Jason Sobel; source: AKG 460B/ck61 > custom pre-amp > Sony D7 (@ 48 kHz) [3]. Also: Transfer from master DATs borrowed from Dave; original 48 kHz wav files archived and available on request [3]
- **gd1994-10-19.137089.sbd.miller.flac1648**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Dat -> Cassette Master -> Dat (48k) [4]
